## Priority Engineering Projects & Case Studies
- [Kaazii](https://www.erbibeksah.com.np/projects/kaazii/): Enterprise multi-tenant project management and HR operations platform featuring schema-isolated PostgreSQL multi-tenancy (`schema_{org_code}`), Next.js 16 App Router, Django REST Framework, Redis WebSocket channels, and MinIO S3 storage.
- [Retirement Benefits Management System](https://www.erbibeksah.com.np/projects/retirement-benefits/): Enterprise pension platform in ASP.NET Core and SQL Server with OCR ingestion, WAF hardening, and 20-25% faster query processing for 50,000+ beneficiaries.
- [AI Exam Proctoring Service](https://www.erbibeksah.com.np/projects/exam-proctoring/): Real-time remote proctoring service with AI computer vision anomaly detection and encrypted WebSockets.
- [Low-Latency Video Streaming CDN](https://www.erbibeksah.com.np/projects/video-cdn/): Scalable video distribution CDN reducing buffer times by 45% via AWS S3, CloudFront edge caching, and signed URLs.
- [DevOps Automation & SCM Modernization](https://www.erbibeksah.com.np/projects/devops-migration/): End-to-end migration from SVN to self-hosted GitLab, containerized Jenkins pipelines, and SonarQube quality gates.
